steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Chat > Chat Access
steps.expected: Browser navigates to the target URL

steps.action: Wait for the page to fully load
steps.expected: Chat Access panel loads successfully without errors

steps.action: Verify the page title or header is correct

steps.action: Verify the left navigation highlights the correct menu item

steps.expected: Key UI elements (buttons, tables, panels) are present

test_create_group.title: Create a group and see it in the conversation list

steps.action: Click the chat icon in the header, then Create Group.
steps.expected: The Create New Group dialog opens with a Group Name field and a member picker.

steps.action: Enter a name, pick the configured chat user as a member, click Create.
steps.expected: The dialog closes and the new group is listed in the conversation list.

test_search_and_send_group_message.title: Open a group from the list and send a message into it

steps.action: Create a group and click its row in the conversation list.
steps.expected: The group thread opens with the message field.

steps.action: Type a message and press Enter.
steps.expected: The message appears in the thread as sent.

test_edit_group_name.title: The group thread's edit icon opens nothing on the current build

steps.action: Create a group and open its thread.
steps.expected: The thread shows edit, delete and info icons.

steps.action: Click the edit icon.
steps.expected: No name field opens (measured 09/08/2026). The test skips; it fails loud the day a field appears so the rename gets a real test.

test_delete_group.title: Delete a group and see it leave the conversation list

steps.action: Create a group and open its thread, then click the delete icon.
steps.expected: A Delete Group confirmation asks whether to delete permanently.

steps.action: Confirm.
steps.expected: The group is no longer listed once the panel is re-opened.
